title: Gridkin Scenario File
description: One feature's worth of Gryphon test scenarios against a named GRIFT fixture. Governed by plugins/gryphon_playground/specs/spec-gridkin-v0.md (req-gridkin-scenario-format, req-gridkin-json-schema).

feature.description: Human-readable description of the feature this file covers.

grift_fixture.description: Path, relative to the plugin root, to the GRIFT fixture that seeds the test database.

soft_delete.description: Entity UUIDs to soft-delete via the service-layer delete_node verb after the GRIFT fixture is imported, before any scenario runs. GRIFT import is additive/upsert-only (spec-grift-v0.md), so soft-deleted graph state is established here.

covers.description: Spec RIDs / ACIDs this scenario exercises. Required and non-empty — traceability is binding.

inspired_by.description: Optional breadcrumb to an openCypher TCK feature folder when the scenario's intent was mined from the TCK. Informational only, never a license claim.

layer.description: GRIFT subgraph return layer to execute at. Defaults to full when omitted.

expected_envelope.description: Path, relative to the plugin root, to the expected response-envelope JSON file.

expected_sql_snapshot.description: Path, relative to the plugin root, to the expected ORM-compiled SQL snapshot file.
